sourceRule: Existing authority only; no capability is created by this artifact.

families.label: Program/project leadership
families.basis: Existing private mapping workflow reports transferable responsibility support; underlying private records are not reproduced.
limits: Does not prove exact title, people management, or domain specialization.

families.label: Cross-functional coordination
families.basis: Existing private job-analysis mappings classify related responsibility support as TRANSFERABLE/PARTIAL.
limits: Scope, stakeholder level, and outcomes require source inspection.

families.label: Architecture and systems work
families.basis: S010.02A identifies repository architecture artifacts as possible future evidence, not current certified career facts.
limits: Repository artifacts alone do not prove professional, production, customer, or employer use.

families.label: AI and automation
families.basis: V1.24 role analyses show transferable mappings, but the repository does not contain inspectable Ross source evidence for exact AI responsibilities.
limits: Do not infer software engineering, data science, or production AI capability.

families.label: Marketing technology and operations
families.basis: V1.24 diagnostics classify MarTech-adjacent roles as transferable/partial; direct evidence is private or unavailable to this audit.
limits: Tool names and job labels are not sufficient proof.

families.label: Data and analytics
families.basis: No repository-visible Ross-specific authoritative evidence was found.
limits: Do not infer data-science/statistical-modeling capability from generic analytics language.

families.label: Technology/tool use
families.basis: Checked-in technology fixtures are synthetic test-only records; real private technology evidence is not inspectable here.
limits: No proficiency, years, production, or customer-use claim without source authority.

families.label: Project-management certification
families.basis: S010.02E reports one owner-private official credential verification; credential details intentionally remain private.
limits: Credential proves only the credential requirement, not employment, scope, years, or program outcomes.

families.label: People management
families.basis: The only repository fixture limits coordination evidence and explicitly does not prove people-management authority.
limits: Do not infer team size, hiring, performance management, or executive scope.

families.label: Business transformation

limits: Outcomes, employer context, and domain depth require evidence review.
